item.title: Krita
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Krita
https://krita.org/
Krita is a free and open source painting program for new and experienced artists. It offers multiple brush types, layers, animation tools, online resources, a supportive community and more.

Features:

- Clean and Flexible Interface

An intuitive user interface that stays out of your way. The dockers and panels can be moved and customized for your specific workflow. Once you have your setup, you can save it as your own workspace. You can also create your own shortcuts for commonly used tools.

item.title: [Meeting] Hillsborough Community Collge Business Industry Leadership Team_NSF_Cloud Computing initiative
item.author: emecas
item.description:
[Meeting] Hillsborough Community Collge Business Industry Leadership Team_NSF_Cloud Computing initiative
Hillsborough Community Collge Business Industry Leadership Team_NSF_Cloud Computing initiative

The new Cloud Computing program at Hillsborough Community College, Tampa Florida.

HCC has received a grant from a National Science Foundation, which is providing the funding for development of a new associate of science degree plan and a college certificate program in cloud computing for the college. To support the new programs, HCC is launching a Business and Industry Leadership Team (BILT) model with business and industry experts to align the new curriculum to industry needs and ensure students are prepared for careers in cloud computing.

item.title: The ReadME Project
item.author: emecas
item.description:
The ReadME Project
https://github.com/readme

About:

Coding is usually seen as a solitary activity, but it’s actually the world’s largest community effort led by open source maintainers, contributors, and teams. These unsung heroes put in long hours to build software, fix issues, field questions, and manage communities.

The ReadME Project is part of GitHub’s ongoing effort to amplify the voices of the developer community. It’s an evolving space to engage with the community and explore the stories, challenges, technology, and culture that surround the world of open source.
